description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EmailConfigurationDao component in the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It tests retrieval and saving functionalities of email configuration data within the plugin's data access layer.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmailConfigurationDao functionalities such as fetching and saving email configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates an EmailConfigurationDao instance, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmailConfigurationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests retrieval of email configuration, asserting that the returned object is an instance of EmailConfiguration.

methods.name: testSaveEmailConfigurationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Tests saving a new email configuration and verifies all fields are correctly set and returned.
